name: @depths/tach
description: Ergonomic cross-platform GPU programming for Typescript
author: Depths AI

scripts.build: deno run -A scripts/build.ts && deno run -A scripts/instructions.ts
scripts.check: deno lint src declarations scripts tests && deno check src/*.ts declarations/*.ts scripts/*.ts tests/*.js && deno run --allow-read scripts/instructions.ts --check
scripts.test: npm run build && deno test -A --node-modules-dir=manual tests
